clips.text: Why does the world use dollars? It's not just America.
clips.phonemes: wˌaɪ dˈʌz ðə wˈɜːld jˈuːs dˈɑːlɚz? ɪts nˌɑːt dʒˈʌst ɐmˈɛɹɪkə.

clips.text: Deep markets make dollars easier to trade and hold.
clips.phonemes: dˈiːp mˈɑːɹkɪts mˌeɪk dˈɑːlɚz ˈiːziɚ tə tɹˈeɪd ænd hˈoʊld.

clips.text: As more people accept them, more connections become possible.
clips.phonemes: æz mˈɔːɹ pˈiːpəl ɐksˈɛpt ðˌɛm, mˈɔːɹ kənˈɛkʃənz bɪkˌʌm pˈɑːsᵻbəl.

clips.text: The dollar leads. But it's not the only global currency.
clips.phonemes: ðə dˈɑːlɚ lˈiːdz. bˌʌt ɪts nˌɑːt ðɪ ˈoʊnli ɡlˈoʊbəl kˈɜːɹənsi.
